l.i: Indulgentiarum doctrinam longè abesse à veritate, anti-

main_text.l: Lutherus duplicem Pontificiorum errorem, circa
Indulgentias, exagitat; vnum in Praxi, quia Indulgen-
tijs abutuntur ad conflandas pecunias: Alterum in do-
ctrina, quia Indulgentias ad animas non solùm viuorum,
verumetiam mortuorum subleuandas, & ex igne expurgato-
rio liberandas valere prædicant: Atq; hoc dogma verum,
piumq; esse decernunt. Bellarminus praxin tàm turpiter
quaestuosam negat; doctrinam verò nouitiam defendit.
Io.[?] de de Praxi, respondet eam esse {g}Nouatorum calumniam,
quà dicitur, Pontifices, per artificium Indulgentia-
rum, opes colligere atque corradere. Verecundiùs multò
Conc. Tridentini Patres, qui reprehendentes {h}Qua-

l.i: estorum abusus, quorum (inquiunt) malitia ita quoti-
die magno fidelium omnium scandalo, & querela deprehendi-
tur, vt de eorum emendatione spes nulla relicta videatur:
Statuit Sancta Synodus, vt post hac in quibuscunque Christia-
næ religionis locis eorum nomen atque vsus penitus aboleatur.

main_text.l: Anigitur tantùm in Quaestores, Pontificum seruos,
culpam hanc transferendam putemus; & Dominos ip-
sos immunes, & nullius criminis affines esse censeamus?

page.notes: The catchword "De" is at the foot right. The Google watermark at bottom right is excluded. Two uncertain readings: "Io.[?]" at the start of the sentence beginning "I°. de de Praxi" (printed text seems to repeat "de"), and the name in note f ("Alphonsi" or "Alphonsu"). The in-text marks {g} and {h} are small superscripts; {g} is inferred from the note letter. The italic status of "Pontifices ... corradere" is slightly uncertain. "Anigitur" is printed as one word and kept as such.
